transcript.content: Hi, I changed my password and now I can't log in to anything.
No problem, it happens. Let's get you sorted. What's your name?
Is it just you or everyone?
Right, so it's just a single user issue. Let me check your account.
Okay. I'm under a bit of time pressure here.
Don't worry, single-user password issues are low priority. I'll fit you in.
I have a court filing deadline at 3pm.
Oh, that is urgent. Let me escalate this.

ticket.description: User James Wilson, Mercer & Tate Law. Single user affected. Cannot log in after password change. Ticket marked as low priority initially.

expected.notes: Candidate categorized as low priority based on single-user scope, ignoring the court filing deadline. Priority/category mismatch — should be high due to legal deadline. Inspired by priority-vs-impact mismatch patterns in helpdesk data.
